verdict.rationale: Muse's documented side chats give separate context for specific topics as projects grow more complex. That is a thin, first-party version of topic-scoped context, but nothing shows multiple chats and files grouped into a project or space with shared instructions. Missing for 10: a project/space container grouping multiple chats, attaching files to a project, shared per-project instructions, detailed docs on how side-chat context is scoped, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions

citations.quote: some people still wanted separate context for certain topics — which made sense as projects grew more complex. So we built side chats.
